prior_result_statute: Documentary re-use of ROOT measured terminal, not a new scientific run or accepted posterior
material_difference_of_current_candidate: Operationally preserves latch/checkpoints/pre-hook and rejects tainted partials. Does not change posterior geometry, prior, sampler, seeds or exploration budget.

alternative_A.name: Retain inherited envelope as operational candidate only
alternative_A.prerequisite_to_propose_any_consumption: A concrete missing operational question that existing doubles/stdlib/imports evidence cannot answer, independent review and one-shot decision; new identity alone insufficient.
alternative_A.qualification_value: Potential real integration evidence if separately justified, not proof of posterior recovery.

alternative_B.name: Distinct recovery/convergence design with explicit resource proposal
preserve: frozen synthetic arrays and analytic PSD
paired noise and fixed injection parameters
sampler method and seeds initially for comparability
guard and fail-closed invalid waveform policy

engineering_proposal_B1.sampler: Same static NestedSampler nlive=256, multi/rwalk, walks=25, dlogz=0.1. No method/prior change proposed inside this candidate.
engineering_proposal_B1.why_material: A finite 10x call ceiling can explore beyond the previous maxcall-limited prefix. It cannot repair native/domain failures or guarantee convergence; no posterior-adjusted prior.
engineering_proposal_B1.basis_for_10x: Explicit engineering capacity proposal, not inferred calls-to-convergence and not an optimized value fitted to the outcome.
engineering_proposal_B1.cost_reference_formula: ROOT prior GR wall_s / 9738 * 100000 per case, at fixed historic mean only; potentially different prior-dependent cost. No new measurement.
engineering_proposal_B1.hard_planning_envelope: At most two sequential children: 28820 nominal supervisor seconds; post-timeout collection and filesystem finalization are not hard realtime.
engineering_proposal_B1.not_resume: Old unit is terminal. A new accepted design would require a fresh full run, with duplicated initial prefix admitted in the cost, never reuse/live resume of uncertain state.
engineering_proposal_B1.decision_required: ROOT/operator must explicitly choose or reject this resource proposal before separate executable contract and input integrity approval; do not mutate the current contract.
engineering_proposal_B1.no_retry_no_extension: Failure, uncertainty or finite cap exhaustion remains terminal. No automatic extra calls, live points, time or seeds.

engineering_alternative_B2.name: Different sampler allocation/method under same physical prior
engineering_alternative_B2.tradeoff: Could reduce wasted likelihood calls but changes sampling path and numerical behavior; needs a separate concrete method justification before implementation, not silent method swap.

acceptance_for_recovery.operational: Every existing guard, identity, pin and input condition must pass; zero denials and no hidden invalid-waveform-to-minus-infinity substitution.
acceptance_for_recovery.convergence: Both planned jobs must reach inherited delta_logz<0.1 before live addition, non-flat live likelihood, below adopted finite cap; weighted ESS>=100; CLEAN_PARTIAL does not satisfy.
acceptance_for_recovery.recovery: Independent interpretation of converged raw weighted diagnostics versus fixed injected truths; truth inclusion alone is not automatic pass, and these two paired realizations do not measure coverage.
acceptance_for_recovery.incomplete: Any nonconverged or ESS-low result leaves recovery/convergence OPEN; failure or uncertainty aborts without retry.
acceptance_for_recovery.D: Even converged two-case recovery does not authorize observed D, population calibration, independent-noise coverage or a physical verdict.

recommendation: Do not launch unchanged envelope by default. First decide whether a distinct recovery design and its finite costs are warranted; B1 is a reviewable engineering proposal, not a forecast of success.
